scenario: Cap test: the 72-hour rule sets the amount, not the 3,000 limit.

She learned of it on 2026-09-01 but cancelled on 2026-09-09, after the 72 hours in 2.3. 72 hours on (2026-09-04) the cruise was 16 days away, so the charge would have been 600, not 2,400.
